title: achillea aizoon
intro: Achillea aizoon, commonly known as Yarrow, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region and Central Asia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, promoting wound healing, and easing digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate menstrual cramps, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
